minutes_text:
Arts Commission

  Inglewood, California
  March 18, 2026

A meeting of the Inglewood Arts Commission convened on March 18, 2026. Chairman
Jacques Lesure called the meeting to order at 6:30 p.m., followed by the flag salute.

Ramara Rubin announced the presence of a quorum as follows:

  Present:
   Commissioner Aletha Metcalf, District No. 1
   Commissioner Olivia Alvitre, District No. 2
   Commissioner Phyllis Battle, District No. 3
   Chairman Jacques Lesure, Commissioner at Large
  Absent:
   Commissioner Anya Christiansen, District No. 4

  City Personnel present were as follows:
   Kerri Arroyo  Library Director
   Ramara Rubin  Secretary

PUBLIC COMMENTS.
  a. None

MINUTES. Commissioner Metcalf moved, and Commissioner Alvitre seconded, that the
minutes for the Arts Commission regular and special meetings held on January 21, 2026
and February 10, 2026 be approved.
The motion was carried by the following roll call vote:
Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Alvitre, Battle, and Lesure
Noes: None

DISCUSSION.
  a. Tracy Michelle of Inglewood Open Studios (IOS) presented the Downtown
  Global Village Project, highlighting a grant opportunity for Inglewood artists
  to create murals in anticipation of increased international attention related to
  FIFA 2026, Super Bowl 2027, and the LA28 Olympic Games.
   Arts Commission

  VERBAL REPORTS-Public Art‐Related Projects.
  a. Allen Frimpong of ZEAL Co-op presented the Creative-Led Community
  Development Initiative, including the feasibility study, and emphasized the
  need to cultivate and support a thriving cultural hub in Downtown Inglewood.
  b. Rasta Asaru Escott EL of Creative House Gallery, discussed Phase 1 of the
  Utility Art Box Program.
  Commissioner Battle made a motion to move, and Commissioner Lesure seconded,
  that Phase 1 for the Utility Art Box program be approved.
  Ayes: Commissioners Metcalf, Alvitre, Battle, and Lesure
  Noes: None
  c. Inglewood Artists Pentathlon - Artist Community Proposal for LA28 Cultural
  Olympiad (Deferred Notation - Acknowledgment of Receipt Only)
  d. Kerri Arroyo, Library Director, provided library updates, including the
  Crenshaw-Imperial Branch mural painted by Library Support Clerk Jeramiah
  Winston, the upcoming 2026 Summer Reading Program “Booked on Art,” and
  Commissioner Metcalf’s participation.
  e. Kerri Arroyo provided an updated on RFP-0258 Public Art Consultant, RFP-
  0259 Crenshaw-Imperial Branch Library Public Art Installation, ongoing
  maintenance of Helen Lundeberg’s Transportation Mural, and the public art
  fund balance and projects.
PUBLIC REMARKS.
  a. Claudia O., expressed appreciation for the Arts Commission meeting,
  highlighting the importance of authentic and genuine projects.
  b. Tracy Michelle inquired about creating a style guide for Downtown
  Inglewood and partnering with Inglewood Open Studios to set standards.
COMMISSIONERS’ COMMENTS/INITIATIVES/ART CALENDAR.
  a. Commissioner Metcalf emphasized the importance of following legal
  procedures and acknowledged City personnel for their efforts in ensuring
  compliance.
  b. Commissioner Alvitre expressed gratitude for the community, thanked City
  personnel and attendees, and emphasized the Commission’s role as a voice
  for the community.

There being no further business to be presented, Chairman Lesure declared the meeting
adjourned at 7:46 p.m.
